verdict.summary: M328 is internally consistent and its NO-GO is correct under the frozen serial selector, 16 B/cycle metadata and 24x naive-metadata gates. No arithmetic cost is counted twice inside any one reported total. However, serial selector+issue addition is a strong no-overlap assumption, and 24x is a naive representation rather than a lower bound. A separate selector with cross-token/group double buffering can reverse the scan and active-list cycle verdict under explicit bandwidth, storage and queue conditions.

conv.method: independent channel-population plus padded 3x3 receptive-field accumulation

raw_int8_error_and_bound.proof: For every omitted active source i and destination j in a group, abs(Wq[j,i]) <= beta[group,i]. Therefore abs(sum_i Wq[j,i]) <= sum_i abs(Wq[j,i]) <= sum_i beta[group,i] <= B. The analyzer checks the signed integer sum per token/group/destination, not only aggregate maxima.
raw_int8_error_and_bound.scope_limit: The proof is in row-wise quantized INT8 accumulator units. Per-row dequantization, model output error and accuracy are not admitted.

dynamic_witness.definition: A fixed module/source/destination-group pair is a witness at one policy iff its dropped-active occurrence count is greater than zero and less than that source's total active occurrence count. Thus the same pair is dropped for some active tokens and kept for other active tokens.

cycle_formula_review.ideal_k8_baseline: For each token and destination group, max over eight banks of active-source population; sum over all token/group tasks.
cycle_formula_review.ideal_k8_candidate: The same max-bank formula after subtracting the group- and budget-specific dropped active prefix.
cycle_formula_review.full_domain_scan96: For nonzero B, tokens * destination_groups * ceil(Nsource/96), added serially to candidate issue.
cycle_formula_review.active_list_lookup8: For nonzero B, destination_groups * sum_token ceil(Nactive(token)/8), added serially to candidate issue; sorting, bucketing and queue conflicts are omitted.
cycle_formula_review.metadata_stream16B: For nonzero B, tokens * destination_groups * ceil(3*Nsource/16), added serially to candidate issue.

double_count_assessment.reason: Full-scan, active-list and metadata-stream are three alternative totals. They are never added to one another. Each adds one selector/read stage to kept-source MAC issue.
double_count_assessment.modeling_pessimism: The serial addition assumes zero overlap between selector/read and issue, including across independent token/group tasks. With separate ports/engines and double buffering, the steady-state lower bound is max(selector work, issue work), not their sum.
double_count_assessment.countervailing_optimism: The active-list model omits the work required to establish beta order and ignores bank/FIFO conflicts; a streaming reinterpretation is valid only when those functions are concretely provisioned.

metadata_review.formula: (3 bytes per pair) / (1 bit per pair) = 24
metadata_review.assessment: The arithmetic is exact for the frozen naive layout, but 24x is not an information-theoretic or architecture lower bound.

streaming_sensitivity.perfect_cross_task_overlap_model: total_cycles = max(candidate_issue_cycles, selector_cycles), ignoring one-time fill/drain over millions of tasks

exact_naive_metadata_bandwidth_condition.remaining_blocker: The exact naive footprint is still 24x, so bandwidth/overlap alone does not pass every frozen gate.

architecture: Use a selector engine physically separate from the eight-bank K8 MAC issue engine, with no shared activation/metadata read-port bottleneck.
Pipeline across independent token/destination-group tasks using ping-pong cutoff/queue state so selector work for task n+1 overlaps issue for task n.
Represent a token/group decision by a cutoff plus stable bank queues, or by stable beta-bucket FIFOs; provision enough state for the observed Conv maximum of 448 active sources.
Preserve stable source-ID order within equal-beta classes and prove that dropped items are a prefix of the ordered active subset.
Measure sorter/bucket latency, queue conflicts, fill/drain, activation bitmap reads and commit stalls; none may be hidden by assertion.
route_a_exact_lossless: Compress exact beta/order metadata to no more than 498816 bytes total, i.e. at most 4 bits per source/group pair on average including indexes and restart state.
Decode at 96 pairs/cycle. A dense three-byte representation requires 288 B/cycle; compressed four-bit symbols require 48 B/cycle before index overhead.
Hide at least 607549919 of the 3502080000 scan cycles for net speedup above one; hide at least 1479072911 for net speedup at least 1.15.
If all conditions hold, the current exact group4/B1024 numeric candidate can reach the 1.7643x overlap lower-bound proxy while preserving its integer bound.
route_b_conservative_four_bit_beta: Store one 4-bit conservative upper-bound beta class per source/group and obtain source IDs from the existing active list; this is exactly 4x the one-bit-mask footprint before dynamic FIFO state.
Lookup and bucket eight active IDs per cycle with at least 4 B/cycle beta-table bandwidth, stable 16-class queues and independent eight-bank issue queues.

Re-run the CPU DSE because upper-bound coding changes beta order and dropped prefixes. The new combined candidate issue count must be at most 5810153280 cycles to retain the 1.15 ideal gate, with zero bound violation, nonzero dynamic witness and exact B0 bypass.
Re-run modified-forward accuracy before any RTL promotion; M333 does not admit accuracy or implementation.

findings.title: Serial selector plus issue is materially over-pessimistic for a decoupled streaming implementation
findings.evidence: At group4/B1024, M328 adds 3.7871B issue and 3.5021B scan cycles to obtain 0.9167x. A two-stage cross-task pipeline has a perfect-overlap lower bound of max(3.7871B,3.5021B), or 1.7643x; only 17.35% of scan work must be hidden to exceed 1x.
findings.impact: M328 validly kills the frozen serial machine, but the README sentence that no worthwhile execution path exists is stronger than the evaluated model.
findings.required_fix: Run a bounded streaming predesign with explicit selector/MAC ports, cutoff queues, per-task fill/drain and conflict accounting before abandoning the mechanism universally.

findings.title: The 24x metadata result is a naive layout fact, not a lower bound
findings.evidence: The frozen layout uses 8-bit beta plus a 16-bit ID. Exact field widths reduce this to a weighted 15.91 bits/pair, while a conservative 4-bit beta class with IDs supplied by an active list reaches the frozen 4x footprint threshold but changes the policy.
findings.impact: The 24x gate blocks M328 exactly as contracted, but it cannot by itself rule out compressed, implicit-ID or conservative-code implementations.
findings.required_fix: Profile lossless block compression with random restart/decode costs, or re-run the DSE with a conservative four-bit upper-bound codebook and stable bucket scheduler.

findings.title: Active-list cost is simultaneously serially pessimistic and microarchitecturally optimistic
findings.evidence: It adds ceil(Nactive/8) serially to issue, yet omits beta ordering, bucket construction, queue conflicts and commit stalls.
findings.impact: Neither 0.7773x serial nor 1.3895x perfect overlap is executable evidence without a queue/sorter schedule.
findings.required_fix: Emit a task-level two-stage schedule with queue occupancy, conflict, fill/drain and shared-port counters.

findings.title: M328 does not report cutoff-rank or scanned-prefix distributions
findings.evidence: The full-domain model charges all Nsource candidates for every nonzero-budget token/group even though the drop boundary may be found earlier; the result retains drop counts but no cutoff rank or early-stop histogram.
findings.impact: A reviewer cannot quantify early termination, cutoff buffering or the true selector/issue overlap from the sealed result.
findings.required_fix: Log per-scope cutoff rank, active prefix length, kept bank populations and selector-to-issue FIFO demand for each budget.

findings.title: The native M328 output manifest is replayable but not sealed
findings.evidence: SOURCE_MANIFEST and SHA256SUMS replay successfully, but no second-level seal file binds SHA256SUMS; the source manifest also directly lists only contract, analyzer and docs359 while other inputs are reached through the contract.
findings.impact: Current bytes and nested identities are consistent, but the package has weaker tamper-evident closure than later milestones.
findings.required_fix: Seal the output manifest and directly bind all contract inputs plus the M51 manifest; retain nested payload hash replay.

admitted: Exact frozen FC1 and selected Conv populations and payload identities
B0 exact bypass for all 28 module/aggregate group rows
Zero observed raw INT8 cumulative-bound violation across the 224 reported rows
Ideal K8 and the three explicitly defined frozen proxy formulas
NO-GO for the exact frozen serial/16B/24x promotion contract
not_admitted: Executable cycles for either M328 or the proposed streaming design
Lossless 4-bit metadata compression or successful conservative 4-bit DSE
RTL, Synopsys, area, power or energy
System speedup, headline or DATE claim
